prompt: What is the name of the father of the first cousin of the mother of the man whose name inspired the naming of the lunar mountain "Mons Hansteen"?
answer: The lunar mountain **Mons Hansteen** was named after **Christopher Hansteen**. His mother, **Anne Cathrine Treschow**, was a first cousin of **Niels Treschow**. The father of Niels Treschow was **Niels Treschow** (the elder).
